{{Quote|It's not me, M'Lady. I worry about you. What if they realize you've left the capital?|Dormé, to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
'''Dormé''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and one of the most devoted [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] during the former [[Queen/Legends|Queen's]] time as the [[Senator/Legends|Senatorial representative]] of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

==Biography==
Dormé was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who [[Naboo (people)/Legends|hailed]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="DB" /> and served as a [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]] for the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. She underwent rigorous training at the hands of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] and his nephew, Captain [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]]. Dormé accompanied Amidala at all times and occasionally adopted senatorial [[Clothing/Legends|robes]] to assume her identity.<ref name="FactFile70" /> When Amidala's tenure ended, she still remained loyal to the former Queen.<ref name="FC">{{ForceCollection|Dormé|star=2}}</ref> Amidala later took on the role of her Naboo's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], still using her tactic of handmaiden bodyguards.<ref name="Chronicles" />

While on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with Amidala in the leadup to voting on the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]], Dormé noticed the growing affection between the Senator and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as she watched from the sidelines.<ref name="DB" />

When Senator Amidala was forced to flee the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] with Skywalker and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], Dormé remained behind, along with Typho, in order to maintain the illusion that Padmé was still on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and thus throw off further [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempts.<ref name="AOTC" />

Though fellow handmaidens [[Cordé/Legends|Cordé]] and [[Versé/Legends|Versé]] had [[Death/Legends|perished]] during an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|earlier attempt]] on the Senator's life, Dormé was willing to put her duty before her own safety in order to act as a decoy for the former [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch]] during the last [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of peace before the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="AOTC" /><ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:DormeSenate-OP.png|thumb|right|180px|Dormé]]
Dormé was courageous<ref name="Galactic Files" /> and both the most devoted<ref name="DB" /> and loyal of Senator<ref name="Chronicles" /> Amidala's aides.<ref name="DB" /> She was ready to take the senator's place whenever a decoy was required.<ref name="Galactic Files" /> The faithful<ref name="Faithful Servant">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/06/imageattack20030613.html|series=Image Attack|text=Faithful Servant}}</ref> handmaiden was suited to her role as she had become one of the senator's closest friends over the years. Dormé was always ready to listen<ref name="FactFile70" /> to her trusted friend<ref name="Chronicles" /> and offer advice. She ensured Amidala that no matter how bleak a situation looked, that she would always have a withstanding companion.<ref name="FactFile70">{{FactFile|70|HAN 9-10|Amidala's Handmaidens}}</ref> Dormé was also a confidant of Amidala, and the two discussed many things, making her aware of Amidala's emotional state.<ref name="FactFile54">{{FactFile|54|HAN 5-8|Amidala's Handmaidens}}</ref> 

Prior to Anakin Skywalker and Amidala leaving Coruscant, Dormé was able to notice their growing affection<ref name="DB" /> more than anyone else,<ref name="FactFile70" /> as she was watching quietly at all times<ref name="DB" /> and found it sweetly amusing.<ref name="Chronicles" /> At first, Dormé found Skywalker's affection for Amidala amusing, though the handmaiden began to worry when Amidala started to reciprocate.<ref name="FactFile70" /> When Dormé helped pack for Amidala's trip to Naboo, the handmaiden giggled after the senator compared Anakin to his younger self.<ref name="Novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> On Amidala's day of departure, Dormé resolved to put on a brave face, but when it was time for her to say goodbye to Amidala, it was too much for her. Dormé started crying for Amidala and what might happen if the assassins knew she had left the capital.<ref name="FactFile70" /> 

The handmaiden stood at 1.65 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="DB" /> and had [[Color/Legends|brown]] eyes, light skin, and brown hair.<ref name="AOTC" /> A lookalike of Amidala,<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2012 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 1|cardname=Dormé (Handmaiden)}}</ref> some considered her remarkable for her beauty and her devotion to the senator.<ref name="FactFile70" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|He'll be safe with me.|Dormé, referring to Captain Typho|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
Dormé was highly trained as a bodyguard.<ref name="DB" /> Like all of Amidala's handmaidens, she underwent rigorous training by Panaka and Typho on Naboo, though the training program had developed somewhat since Amidala's first group of handmaidens had been chosen.<ref name="FactFile70" /> The handmaiden had high intelligence, above average diplomacy skills, a slightly above average fighting ability, and average strength and speed. She was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].<ref name="Galactic Files" />

==Behind the scenes==
===From Sydney girl to regal servant===
{{Quote|What really helped me get into the character of Dormé was definitely her costume. It was so regal that it made me walk and behave very differently than a twenty-two-year-old Sydney girl. Her entire role really is to support Amidala, and her safety is Dormé's top priority. That helped give me focus.|Rose Byrne|<ref name="Insider 61">{{InsiderCite|61|Rose Byrne: A Rose by Any Other Name}}</ref>}}
[[File:Rose Byrne.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Dormé was portrayed by Australian actor Rose Byrne.]]
The character of Dormé was portrayed by Australian actor [[Rose Byrne]] in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. Bryne acted in a performance of<ref name="Insider 61" /> stage play<ref name="Insider 51">{{InsiderCite|51|Meet the New Stars of Episode II}} </ref> ''La Dispute'' with fellow actor [[Leeanna Walsman]] for the [[Wikipedia:Sydney Theatre Company|Sydney Theatre Company]], when Episode II casting director [[Robin Gurland]] spotted her. Gurland knew she wanted Bryne for the film and the two met around six months before filming for the film started in Sydney, Australia. Byrne thought her role had been given to Walsman when she was cast for the film, but she was eventually able to audition for the role of Dormé at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]].<ref name="Insider 61" />

In an effort to learn her part, Byrne watched the previous entry in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars saga|saga]], [[1999]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], but didn't understand some parts of the film, even after repeated watches. On her twelve days on the set of Episode II, Byrne's costume, a regal outfit that caused her to walk and behave differently, helped her get into character. Some of Byrne's scenes were shot on blue screen, causing her to become sympathetic to actors who had to work among it.<ref name="Insider 61" /> During Anakin Skywalker's outburst while Amidala packs, Dormé was scripted to quietly laugh, though it is not seen in the film.<ref name="DB" />

===Decoy revealed===
{{Quote|But&hellip; of course, of course, of course!|Rose Bryne, on if she wanted to reprise the role of Dormé|<ref name="Insider 61" />}} 
Byrne's casting and role as a handmaiden<ref name="Insider 51" /> was first revealed on [[June 24]], [[2000]] with the release of the [[StarWars.com]] article "Casting Update: Local Talent."<ref name="LocalTalent">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/production/news20000624.html|text=Casting Update: Local Talent}}</ref> The character would later be revealed and named in the "[[Prequel Update]]" section of the [[Star Wars Insider 56|fifty-sixth]] issue of the magazine<ref name="Insider 56">{{InsiderCite|56|Prequel Update}}</ref> released around [[September 11]], 2001.<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20010820.html|text=Inside the DVD: ''Insider'' #56}}</ref> Dormé then first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 1|first]] issue of Episode II's [[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones (comic series)|comic adaptation]]<ref name="AOTCcomic">[[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 1|''Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones'' 1]]</ref> on [[April 17]], [[2002]],<ref name="ComicDate">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/00-468/Star-Wars-Episode-II----Attack-of-the-Clones-1|text=Star Wars: Episode II -- Attack of the Clones #1}}</ref> ahead of the film's release on [[May 16]], 2002.<ref name="YearbyYear">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> The issue was written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and drawn by [[Jan Duursema]].<ref name="AOTCcomic" />

When interviewed in "[[Rose Byrne: A Rose by Any Other Name|Rose Byrne: A Rose By Any Other Name,]]" an article authored by [[Michael G. Ryan]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 61|sixty-first]] issue of ''Insider''<ref name="Insider 61" /> on [[August 2]], 2002,<ref name="61Release">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20020710.html|text=New US, German and French Fan Magazines}}</ref> Byrne revealed that she would be open to reprising the role of Dormé, though if it was to happen was out of her hands.<ref name="Insider 61" />
